Risk Description: Data quality in source systems is poor and undocumented
Mitigation Strategy: Profile all sources during discovery; define quality thresholds before build
Contingency Plan: Implement quarantine pattern for bad data; alert and skip rather than fail

Risk Description: Key stakeholders are not aligned on platform requirements
Mitigation Strategy: Run alignment workshop early; get written sign-off on requirements
Contingency Plan: Escalate to sponsor; descope to areas of agreement

Risk Description: Client SMEs are not available when needed for requirements and validation
Mitigation Strategy: Agree on SME availability in charter; schedule sessions 2 weeks ahead
Contingency Plan: Document assumptions; validate incrementally rather than in big batches

Risk Description: Migration of legacy data is more complex than estimated
Mitigation Strategy: Run a proof-of-concept migration for the most complex source first
Contingency Plan: Phase migration; defer low-priority historical data

Risk Description: End users resist switching from existing tools and processes
Mitigation Strategy: Start change management in week 1; involve champions early
Contingency Plan: Run old and new in parallel; provide hands-on support during transition

Risk Description: Platform vendor pricing or licensing changes during project
Mitigation Strategy: Lock in pricing before project start; review contract terms
Contingency Plan: Identify alternative platforms; design for portability

Risk Description: Scope creep from additional data sources or use cases
Mitigation Strategy: Maintain a strict change request process; track all scope additions
Contingency Plan: Defer new scope to a follow-up phase

Risk Description: Sensitive data is exposed due to inadequate access controls
Mitigation Strategy: Define access model in design phase; review with security team
